subject: Great ideas for a reboot
author: Xandu
body:
Lots of good ideas Suf.

I've always wanted a Burnout Collected Works. All the cars, tracks and game modes from Burnout, Burnout 2, Burnout 3, Burnout Dominator and Burnourt Revenge... Video recording would be a must, available disk space should limit length. Publishing to Skydrive (or other online drive) as a minimum. Also a spectator mode (with possibility to record) would be cool and innovative.

subject: yes, Yes, YES!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I agree with everything.

And I hope if 'they' are reading, that they are listening, at least a little bit.

I am sooooooo bored of driving real cars in real environments with real physics it's just real boring for me.

I miss the creativity of invention, made up cars, made up environments, made up physics.

Although I don't miss the challenges, they got old fast. I do miss Road Rage circa Takedown and other game modes that with the right room of people make you want to play all night long. Challenges didn't do that, or maybe we never got the right group of people together?

I think stunt runs have more potential, they were more fun anyway.... possibly the most fun I had in an open environment, at least I understood the point once I got the hang of it.

Xandu doesn't think this should have been a comment on a poll, but I said you can put it wherever you like Suf! :)

I like that it's just us, although, I like it when it's other people too! so, come on if you are reading this.... join us and tell us what you think!

subject: I love that it just 'Us'
author: SUFFUR
body:
But who is reading?

But since Crash bless it, is older, and NFS :MW is ok, NFS:HP, showed that online functionality  is finer that the rest but Revenge needs a reboot but so do they all.

Bring Burnout Back, bring in Explosive Crash Breakers to Online, keep the Strength of Cars from Takedown, then all the roads ever made will be ours, and all the cars. But I do miss Le Challenges from Paradise plus it's laid out interface and even the spins and flips, but all is too slow compared to Revenge!

Bring the Tanker and it's potential explosive nature and the Tuk-Tuk back, keep dead traffic on the road, but put in a ram, even some of those spike strips, how about oil slick or even mines or burning oil with spike strips and some mines, with 'i'm on fire have a flat tire, flipped over back on to my sparking rims because of those mines, thanks and still took you down', 'cheivo!

Computer game racing is slowly decaying into realism and simulation, and just because once in a while i might like to drive off a cliff, i really don't like being told to repeatedly.

And going by all the crash 'junktions' in Revenge Lone Peak looked great as a race space then again so did they all.

Also a recording facility longer than 30 second would be nice.

Your thoughs?

PS a rather not have customisation, beyond a colour pallete and Tag, but some of the mod ideas were interesting, then again how about track mods, upside down, jelly tracks, overhead (also useful for a spectator mode) or just Tuk-Tuk's and Tankers, yes i miss then, lol.

Anyhew people Dream on!;)

But this looks sweet btw. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wK5f7az5dIY&feature=youtu.be
